name: river-levels
description: Current USGS streamflow and gage height, compared with past years.

interface.longDescription:
Check river flow and gage height at USGS stream gauges before a paddling, fishing or riverside trip, with live readings from USGS Water Services and a printable condition sheet.

Find gauges by US state and river name, or near a US city or town. For up to 10 gauges, see the latest discharge (cubic feet per second) and gage height (feet) with the local reading time, the change over the last 24 hours and over 1 to 7 days, and a rising, falling or steady trend with a stated threshold. Each gauge is compared with USGS daily statistics for the same calendar day: the percentile band, the median and the percent of median, with the years of record.

Download a PDF condition sheet with a chart per gauge and a CSV of the readings in the period. Results name the source, its address and the retrieval time in UTC.

Recent USGS readings are provisional and can be revised. The percentile band compares an instantaneous reading with daily-mean statistics. When USGS does not answer, the gauge is marked as source unavailable; if this server received readings for it in the last 24 hours, those are shown as a saved reading with the time they were retrieved, otherwise no values are shown. This is not a forecast or a flood warning; follow National Weather Service warnings and local officials for safety decisions. Download links expire in about one hour.
defaultPrompt: River levels for USGS gauges 01646500 and 01638500 over the last 7 days, with a PDF sheet
Find river gauges on the Arkansas River in Colorado
Which USGS stream gauges are within 15 miles of Boulder, CO?

positive.prompt: What is the river flow and gage height at USGS gauge 01646500 over the last 7 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns current discharge and gage height per gauge with local reading time, 24-hour trend, percentile band for this calendar day, provisional flag, USGS source and retrieval time, and PDF and CSV download links.

positive.description: Find gauges by state and river
positive.prompt: Find river gauges on the Arkansas River in Colorado
positive.expected_behavior: Returns active USGS stream gauges in Colorado whose names match Arkansas, with site numbers, gauge pages and the USGS source and retrieval time.

positive.prompt: Which USGS stream gauges are within 15 miles of Boulder, CO?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns active USGS stream gauges sorted by distance from the matched city Boulder, CO, with site numbers and distances in miles.

positive.prompt: River levels for USGS gauges 01646500 and 01638500 over the last 3 days, with a PDF sheet
positive.expected_behavior: Returns current discharge and gage height per gauge with local reading time, 24-hour trend, percentile band for this calendar day, provisional flag, USGS source and retrieval time, and PDF and CSV download links.

positive.prompt: List river gauges within 10 miles of Washington, DC
positive.expected_behavior: Returns active USGS stream gauges sorted by distance from the matched city Washington, DC, including gauges across state lines.

negative.prompt: Will the river flood next week?
negative.description: Do not call a tool; the tools report current readings and statistics, not forecasts or flood warnings.

negative.prompt: What is the tide at Santa Monica pier tomorrow?
negative.description: Do not call a tool; tides are outside USGS river gauge readings.

negative.prompt: Book a guided rafting trip on the Arkansas River
negative.description: Do not call a tool; booking trips is outside river gauge readings.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: USGS gauge search by state, river name or nearby city; current discharge and gage height, 24-hour trend, percentile band for the calendar day, PDF condition sheet and CSV of readings.

pl-PL.subtitle: Przepływ i poziom rzek USGS
pl-PL.description: Sprawdź aktualny przepływ i poziom wody na wodowskazach USGS w USA, trend z ostatnich 24 godzin i porównanie z tym samym dniem w poprzednich latach. Pobierz arkusz PDF z wykresami i plik CSV z odczytami. Najnowsze dane są wstępne. To nie jest prognoza ani ostrzeżenie powodziowe.

de-DE.subtitle: USGS-Abfluss und Pegel
de-DE.description: Aktuellen Abfluss und Pegelstand an USGS-Messstellen in den USA prüfen, mit 24-Stunden-Trend und Vergleich mit demselben Kalendertag früherer Jahre. PDF-Zustandsblatt mit Diagrammen und CSV der Messwerte herunterladen. Neue Werte sind vorläufig. Keine Vorhersage und keine Hochwasserwarnung.

es-ES.subtitle: Caudal y nivel de ríos USGS
es-ES.description: Consulta el caudal y el nivel actuales en estaciones de aforo del USGS en EE. UU., la tendencia de 24 horas y la comparación con el mismo día de años anteriores. Descarga una hoja PDF con gráficos y un CSV con las lecturas. Los datos recientes son provisionales. No es un pronóstico ni una alerta de inundación.

fr-FR.subtitle: Débit et niveau USGS
fr-FR.description: Consultez le débit et la hauteur d'eau actuels aux stations USGS aux États-Unis, la tendance sur 24 heures et la comparaison avec le même jour des années passées. Téléchargez une fiche PDF avec graphiques et un CSV des relevés. Les données récentes sont provisoires. Ce n'est ni une prévision ni une alerte crue.

ja-JP.subtitle: USGS河川の流量と水位
ja-JP.description: 米国USGS観測所の現在の流量と水位、24時間の傾向、過去の同じ日との比較を確認できます。グラフ付きPDFシートと測定値のCSVをダウンロードできます。最新値は暫定値です。予報や洪水警報ではありません。

pt-BR.subtitle: Vazão e nível de rios USGS
pt-BR.description: Veja a vazão e o nível atuais em estações do USGS nos EUA, a tendência de 24 horas e a comparação com o mesmo dia em anos anteriores. Baixe uma folha PDF com gráficos e um CSV das leituras. Dados recentes são provisórios. Não é previsão nem alerta de enchente.
